_readme: CANONICAL STRUCTURED-CONTENT FIXTURES — one file, three consumers.
The server embeds structured blocks in the assistant TEXT stream as bracketed markers.
Web, Android and iOS each re-implement the decode+strip independently, and they have already
drifted twice in production (raw [CTA_BUTTONS] JSON on Android; raw [TAPPY_SHOPPING] JSON on
iOS). This file is the shared conformance suite that turns 'keep three parsers in sync by hand'
into a test that fails when they drift.
CONSUMERS (all three MUST pass every case):
Web      src/lib/structuredContent/markerFixtures.test.ts
Android  android/app/src/test/java/com/tappyai/app/chat/ChatResponseFixtureConformanceTest.kt
iOS      ios/TappyAITests/ContentParserFixtureConformanceTests.swift
RULES A PARSER MUST SATISFY (V3_PLATFORM_PARITY.md §4.2):
1. Strip is unconditional and independent of decode — a block that cannot be decoded is
still a block the user must never read.
2. Four shapes per marker: closed, bare, unterminated, orphan tag.
3. Never end-anchor a bare block — another marker may follow it.
4. Never use greedy {[\s\S]*} — it swallows trailing prose to the last brace.
5. Stripping must not delete unrelated content.
6. Adding a marker server-side requires all three clients updated in the same change.
FIELD SEMANTICS:
input                    the raw assistant content as the client receives it
expectVisibleContains    substrings the user MUST still read
expectVisibleNotContains substrings that must NEVER reach the user (marker names AND payload)
expectCtaLabels          decoded CTA button labels, in order ([] = none decoded)
expectFollowups          decoded follow-up chips, in order
expectPlanPresent        whether a plan decoded into its model
expectPlacesCount        how many durable places decoded from [TAPPY_PLACES] (0 = none)
expectPlaceNames         those places' names, IN ORDER (omitted when the count is 0)
Adding a marker server-side? Add its cases here FIRST, watch all three fail, then fix all three.

cases.description: Normal complete CTA block. Baseline: all three already pass this.
cases.input:
Quán này ngon lắm.
[CTA_BUTTONS]{"buttons":[{"label":"Xem bản đồ","type":"maps","url":"https://maps.example/a","primary":true}]}[/CTA_BUTTONS]

cases.description: D2 — THE PRODUCTION LEAK SHAPE. The model omits the closing tag and emits [FOLLOWUPS] after the CTA block. An end-anchored bare pattern cannot match, so the buttons are lost; on a parser whose safety net strips only the TAG, the raw JSON is then rendered as message body. Android leaked exactly this on 2026-08-27.
expectVisibleContains: Mình tìm ốp lưng cho bạn nhé.

cases.description: D2 (second half) — prose AFTER a bare CTA block must survive. A greedy or end-anchored strip deletes it; iOS's residue pattern deleted everything to end-of-message.
A closing brace inside a JSON string must not end the scan early. Rule 4 — brace matching must honour strings and escapes.
A block still arriving mid-stream: braces do not balance. Nothing decodes, and nothing leaks.
cases.input:
Đang tìm giúp bạn.
[CTA_BUTTONS]{"buttons":[{"label":"Shopee","type":"sea

cases.input:

[/CTA_BUTTONS]

cases.description: The server never emits this, but a client must not build an empty card from it either: an empty list decodes to no places at all.
cases.input:
Chưa tìm được quán nào.
[TAPPY_PLACES]{"v":1,"items":[]}[/TAPPY_PLACES]

cases.description: A payload from a NEWER server than this client. Web (the reference implementation) does not gate on `v` — it decodes whatever carries a non-empty `items` — so the other platforms must not reject it either, or a version bump breaks mobile silently.
cases.input:
Quán này ngon.
[TAPPY_PLACES]{"v":99,"items":[{"id":"place:osm:1","domain":"food","kind":"place","rank":0,"actions":[],"name":"Quán Tương Lai"}]}[/TAPPY_PLACES]

cases.description: A full production reply carrying every marker. Prose survives, every block is consumed, and the CTA is in the BARE form with followups trailing — the combination that broke Android.
cases.input:
[TAPPY_SHOPPING]{"entities":[{"name":"Air M1","matchesRequest":"khop"}]}[/TAPPY_SHOPPING]

Mình nghiêng về **Air M1** nhé.
